title: ezechiel203@big.docbetry.fr
P1-5: FUSE journal silent data loss under backpressure
description:
Sonnet §5 H-4. Elevated to P1 by structural severity (data integrity).
File: crates/pcloud-fs/src/journal.rs:50-54.
Problem: WritebackJournal::append silently evicts the oldest entry at capacity (4096). Data loss with no error returned.
Remediation: Return Err(JournalError::AtCapacity) when pending.len() == max_pending_operations. Callers must flush or fail the write.
Complexity: small; callers must be updated to propagate.
Paired fix (Opus §5 M-4): add aggregate total_staging_bytes ceiling across all inodes to prevent disk-fill attacks (see P2-1f).
§citation: Sonnet §5 H-4 (direct source inspection confirms silent eviction; Opus §5 M-4 flags analog staging-ceiling gap).
closed_reason: Fixed: journal::WritebackJournal::append now returns JournalError::Full at capacity instead of silently evicting. Callers (writeback::WritebackService::stage_write, FilesystemShell::journal_write) propagate the error for back-pressure. Added enqueue_rejects_when_full_not_evict_oldest test.

description:

P2-1b eprintln! in production read path: backend.rs:304-310. Fix: replace with log::trace!.
P2-1c BSD+Windows signal-driven mount cleanup absent: platform/bsd.rs + platform/windows.rs register no SIGTERM/SCM STOP reaper. Fix: parallel sigaction reaper for BSD (mirror linux.rs:659-722); SetConsoleCtrlHandler + SCM stop callback for WinFSP. Opus §5 M-1.
P2-1d ACTIVE_MOUNTS canonicalization race: linux.rs:630-646. Fix: capture canonical PathBuf once in LinuxMountHandle, reuse on register/unregister. Opus §5 M-2.
P2-1e Reaper silent .ok() spawn: linux.rs:690-696. Fix: panic in debug, log::error! in release, refuse mount if spawn fails. Opus §5 M-3.
P2-1f Aggregate staging ceiling absent: write_path.rs:291-313. Fix: total_staging_bytes computed from StagingDir size; fail new create_blob with ENOSPC at ceiling. Opus §5 M-4.
P2-1g Chunked upload_write pipelining absent: blocks multi-GiB write claims for bd-1du.10. Fix: implement upload_chunk_begin/write/finish in PcloudFsBackend and wire flush loop. Opus §5 M-5.
P2-1h invalidate_file O(n) holds global cache mutex: page_cache.rs:293-306. Fix: add secondary index file_id -> Vec<PageKey>; reduce to O(k). Sonnet §5 H-5 (direct source inspection confirms O(n) scan).
§citation: Opus §5 L-3/M-1..M-5 + Sonnet §5 C-1/C-2/H-5.
closed_reason: Fixed audit-05 P2-1 FUSE correctness items (a,b,d,e,h) and P2-7a systemd FUSE deployment: (a) FileHandle.size=0: added FileBackend::open_with_size default, ProtoFuseAdapter populates file_sizes from listfolder, plus stat_returns_real_size_on_open live test. (b) eprintln->log::debug in backend read path. (d) page_cache invalidate_file now O(k) via by_file secondary index. (e) ProtoUploadBackend implements chunked upload_create/write/save/status; whole-file fallback capped at 4 MiB. (P2-7a) Added override-fuse.conf.example + packaging/systemd/README.md; updated pcloudd.service header. cargo test -p pcloud-fs -p pcloud-proto -p pcloud-backends green. Signals (c) and reaper (f) remain tracked under audit-05 .20/.30 beads.
